approved: Savoy Drugstore is a UAE-based B2B regulatory services company.
Savoy supports product registration, documentation review, authority coordination and regulatory advisory.
Savoy supports brands, clinics, manufacturers and distributors seeking compliant UAE market entry.
Savoy works across cosmetics, personal care, haircare, aesthetics, wellness and professional-use product categories.
Medical, injectable and professional-use products are supplied exclusively to licensed healthcare facilities in accordance with applicable regulations.
Savoy’s regulatory journey can include documentation review, compliance assessment, regulatory preparation, authority submission, coordination and approval/market-readiness support.
